title: District of West Vancouver 2024 Statement of Financial Information: employees
scopeDescription: Published named employee schedule, including any published threshold exceptions
notes: Calendar-year named employee disclosure; amounts are remuneration as published and may include overtime, retroactive pay, taxable benefits, leave payouts and other compensation. They are not annual base salary rates.

Expenses are kept separately from remuneration. Published dashes and blank expenses remain null; explicit zero and negative amounts are retained. Names, initials and available positions are preserved as disclosed; they do not establish unique person identities.
Only the employee schedule is imported. Elected officials, supplier payments, aggregate under-threshold payroll and employer pension/insurance contributions are outside this collection.

Printed component subtotals and the sum of printed individual rows differ by [3.0, -2.0] CAD in source column order (or explicit total remuneration and expenses where only those subtotals are printed). Published row values are retained without adjustments. Whole-dollar reports can exhibit rounding residuals; the exact observed differences are pinned for revalidation.
2026-11-06 title recovery: corrected titles formerly concatenated into names; every observation, amount, expense and physical page is unchanged.
